summary: Phase 3 (Wallet+Razorpay mock+Checkout) and Phase 4 (Order Detail + Invoice) FRONTEND validation on web preview. Order Detail screen renders correctly for all 3 payment types (Razorpay PAID, Wallet PAID, COD) with proper subtotal/delivery/wallet-applied/payable/payment-method/payment-status fields and Download invoice + Track live on map CTAs. CRITICAL BLOCKER: react-native-webview does not run on web — every Razorpay mock flow (wallet top-up AND checkout-pay-via-Razorpay) lands on a screen that literally says 'React Native WebView does not support this platform.' so the user can never click 'Simulate success' on web preview. CRITICAL BUG: AddressAuthSync component is implemented in src/components but never mounted in app/_layout.tsx, so useAddressStore.setAuthToken is never called → addresses never load from server on login and addressStore.upsert never POSTs to /api/addresses. Status timeline on Order Detail also appears to highlight ALL 4 steps for a 'pending' order (should only highlight 'Order placed').

ui_bugs.issue: Mock Razorpay screen renders body text 'React Native WebView does not support this platform.' on web preview. No Simulate success/failure buttons reachable → wallet top-up via Razorpay AND checkout with payment_method=razorpay cannot be completed on web. Reproduces on /profile/wallet → + Add money → Pay ₹500 AND on /checkout → select 'UPI / Cards / Netbanking' → Pay & place order. POST /api/payments/razorpay/create-order returns 200 (mode=mock) but the embedded mock HTML never paints because react-native-webview has no web shim. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/RazorpayCheckout.tsx

AddressAuthSync component exists at src/components/AddressAuthSync.tsx but is NEVER imported/mounted in app/_layout.tsx. Consequence: useAddressStore.setAuthToken is never invoked, loadFromServer never runs, server-side addresses never appear on /checkout, and addressStore.upsert never pushes to POST /api/addresses (verified via network panel — no /api/addresses GET or POST is ever made from the app). Customer who creates an address on Phone A will not see it on Phone B; also blocks /checkout for any user whose only addresses live on the server.

For a status='pending' order, all 4 timeline steps (Order placed / Accepted / Out for delivery / Delivered) render with filled orange check icons as if completed. Expected: only the current/past steps highlighted, future steps muted. Reproduces by opening any /order/{id} where status=pending (e.g. ord_c5ecdd32f7e8).

When wallet_applied=0 the screen uses the label 'Total ₹X' instead of 'Payable ₹X'. When wallet_applied>0 it correctly switches to 'Payable'. Minor inconsistency vs spec which asks for explicit Payable line on every order.

Tapping the 'Use wallet balance' Switch on the web preview appeared to also fire the 'Place order' button on the same gesture (a COD order ord_c5ecdd32f7e8 was placed without explicit tap). Couldn’t reproduce 100% deterministically but happened on first attempt with viewport 390x844. Worth double-checking pointer-event bubbling on the row.

integration_issues.issue: Cannot complete on web preview — WebView dead end. Backend create-order returns 200 but no way to invoke /payments/razorpay/verify from UI.
Same WebView dead end. POST /api/payments/razorpay/create-order fires but verify never does → wallet balance never credits via this path on web.

integration_issues.flow: Login → Address book hydration from server
integration_issues.issue: AddressAuthSync not mounted → /api/addresses GET never called, server addresses invisible in UI even though backend persists them correctly.

issues: Status timeline visually shows all steps complete even when status=pending — misleading users.

Payment status pill text is 'COD' / 'PAID' but raw text only; couldn't confirm yellow background for COD vs green for PAID in plaintext extraction (screenshot suggests pills exist but worth designer pass).
When WebView fails, the user sees raw red error text 'React Native WebView does not support this platform.' with no friendly fallback or Close + Retry CTA at the bottom (only the X in the header).

react_native_issues.issue: Library has no web implementation (renders the literal error text on Platform.OS==='web'). Phase 3 mock Razorpay UI relies on it → entire Razorpay flow is unusable on web preview. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/RazorpayCheckout.tsx and any consumer that mounts the mock checkout sheet.

action_items: P0: Make Razorpay mock screen work on Platform.OS==='web'. Either (a) replace WebView with a plain React-Native View that renders the same Simulate success/failure buttons (cleanest — and matches the 'mock-mode' contract), or (b) render the mock HTML inside a real iframe on web while keeping WebView for native.

P0: Mount <AddressAuthSync /> inside app/_layout.tsx (e.g. right next to the existing hydrateAddresses call). Without this the address book never syncs and /checkout shows 'No saved addresses yet' for any user whose addresses only live server-side.
P1: Fix status timeline in app/order/[id].tsx so only steps at/before the current status are highlighted; current code paints all four as completed.
P2: Always show 'Payable' line in order payment summary (even when wallet_applied=0) for consistency with spec.
P2: Audit the Switch in app/checkout.tsx — verify a tap doesn’t bubble to the underlying 'Place order' button (saw one accidental COD order placed during switch tap).
critical_code_review_comments: src/components/AddressAuthSync.tsx is dead code today — nothing imports it. Either mount it in the root layout or delete it; current state silently breaks the entire server-side address sync.

src/components/RazorpayCheckout.tsx hard-depends on react-native-webview without a Platform.select fallback — this is the single point of failure for both wallet top-up and online checkout on web preview.
app/order/[id].tsx status timeline does not gate the 'completed' style by current status — likely an Array.map without index<currentStep check.

Also re-verify status timeline only highlights up to current status. Use http://localhost:3000 — Expo serves the app, API hits the public backend URL from frontend/.env.
rca_of_issue: Razorpay-on-web RCA: src/components/RazorpayCheckout.tsx mounts a WebView from 'react-native-webview' to host the mock checkout HTML. react-native-webview ships an empty web shim that simply renders the literal text 'React Native WebView does not support this platform.', so the mock UI never paints on Platform.OS==='web'. Fix is platform-split: on web, replace WebView with native View+TouchableOpacity buttons that call the same onSuccess/onFailure callbacks the WebView postMessage path uses. Address-sync RCA: app/_layout.tsx calls hydrateAddresses() (local cache load) but never wires the AuthContext token into useAddressStore. The bridge component src/components/AddressAuthSync.tsx that does useEffect(()=>setAuthToken(token),[token]) is implemented but unused, so loadFromServer + upsert-to-server never run. Mount it inside the RootLayout tree (e.g. inside the SafeAreaProvider) and the issue disappears.
